feeds.title: Living Well Mom
feeds.description: Living Well Mom was started in 2007 by Erika Bragdon as a way to recount her adventures as a stay-at-home mom. She enjoys blogging as a hobby and has incorporated her love for healthy living. With all her experiences, she writes about practical tips and valuable advice on healthy family recipes, natural wellness tips, parenting, relaxation, essential oils, DIY ideas, and fun things to do with kids.

feeds.title: Juggling Act Mama
feeds.description: Juggling Act Mama is a lifestyle blog for busy women - especially moms - that want to do it all. Here you'll find amazing recipes, fantastic projects, and incredible travel ideas for living your best life.

feeds.title: The Fashionable Housewife Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sarah-Jean. I'm a Christian, the wife of a handsome Molecular Biologist, and the homeschooling mother of 5 beautiful kids! This blog is a place for me to share how we live and what I love most. I'm on a mission to help busy moms like you, be fashionable too!
